Name: Fishing Info Overlays
Author: barteke22
Description:
[color=yellow][center][youtube]GycEDQOfOZg[/youtube][/center]

General info:[/color]
This mod only displays information about the fish (and fishable items) available in your area, as well as a preview during the fishing minigame. It does not alter any mechanics and has been coded to be as compatible with other fish-related mods as possible. It's very customisable, check out the screenshots.

Uses Data\\Fish + Fishing Simulation combo, for best mod compatibility. This method simulates the fishing minigame at a configurable interval (per UI Update) after getting the generic fish data. The higher the interval, the more accurate (and less glitchy looking) the information, but also higher performance cost. This should be near 100% accurate for anything (vanilla or modded) that uses the fishing minigame (getFish method).

[color=yellow]Project story:[/color][spoiler]
This little project started out as me wanting to update Teh's Overhaul, because even the unofficial 1.5 update appears to outright prevent you from obtaining certain 1.5 items, and requires tonnes of workarounds for certain modded fish. Teh's Overhaul is, as the name suggests, an overhaul - meaning it has its own logic for the fishing minigame. I was mainly interested in the overlay portion of it, since there's plenty of decent alternatives on the minigame difficulty front. That mod however, is pretty massive - with data spread across many files, classes and APIs. I quickly gave up on trying to make any sense of it, decided to start from scratch and properly wrap my head around how the vanilla game does its thing.

So is this actually based on Teh's Overhaul? Well, yes, but actually... who knows? The visual concept/initial idea maybe, but the code is purely SMAPI/Vanilla Stardew based.
[/spoiler]


[color=yellow][size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color][b]
[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Download and Install [/b]the latest version of [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. [/b]Made for 3.10+, earlier versions might not work.
[b][/b]
[*][Optional][b] Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [/b](GMCM)[b]. [/b]If you want an easy way to customise the overlays on the fly, with in-depth explanations.
[b][/b]
[*][b]Download[/b] this mod from [b]Files[/b], and [b]unzip [/b]the [b]FishingInfoOverlays [/b]folder into your [b]Mods [/b]folder.[b][/b]

[/list]


[color=yellow][size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][u][b]
[/b][/u][/size][/color][list]
[*] Tested with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Ridgeside Village, Stardew Aquarium, Fishing Made Easy Suite, Fishing Minigames. Anything that adds fish via proper mechanics should work, and mods that modify difficulty via simple ways like Content Patcher should be fine.
[*]This covers mostly different features than Fish Helper UI, and should be fully compatible. You can disable various features from this mod if you prefer that one's UI.
[/list][list]
[*][u]Location bar[/u]: By default it checks the Fish Data (less accurate percentages). It can be configured to instead simulate the location's getFish (fishing minigame's success method) X times per UI Update. Meaning that any fish obtainable through the location's getFish should be found. Either should work unless a mod completely overhauls the vanilla fishing.
[/list][list]
[*][u]Minigame[/u]: Gets the active BobberBar's current fish and its position (plus some extra bits). It should work unless a mod completely overhauls the vanilla fishing, though it might still work if said mod updates BobberBar's variables.
[*]Singleplayer, multiplayer and split screen (local coop).
[/list]

[color=yellow][size=4][b]Issues:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Some items and locations had to be hardcoded to work and appear on preview: Golden Walnuts, Spines, Skulls, CalderaPainting (furniture), Railroad and IslandFarmCave (locations). Can't really do anything, as the game uses Game1.player directly there instead of the provided 'who'. As a side effect of this the overlay became a bit psychic on Ginger Island - predicting if next click on one of the nearest water tiles will grant certain items.
[*]Minor flicker/jumping when using magic bait in some locations. It's because some items are less than 1% chance then.
[/list]

[color=yellow][size=4][b]Config (without GMCM):[/b][/size][/color]
[spoiler]
From version 1.1.0, most of the variables are arrays of 4 - representing each split-screen screen, GMCM has a proper setup for this. Manual example:
"BarIconMode": [
    2, ﻿- This is screen 1: Split-screen host, or any non split-screen player.
    0, ﻿- This is screen 2: Split-screen (top) right. Non split-screen players can ignore this and the next 2 values.
    1, ﻿- Screen 3.
    0 ﻿- Screen 4.
  ]

[b]Just like in GMCM, if you're holding a fishing rod in game (near water), you can preview any changes made to the config.json (save it first) by pressing F5.[/b]
If you're using GMCM it has detailed ingame explanations of each position, otherwise run the game once to generate the config.json for this mod:
[list]
[*][u]BarSonarMode (0-3)[/u]: Defines what doesn't function without Sonar Bobber: 0= Whole mod , 1= Minigame preview, 2= Shift Aim, 3= Nothing.
[*][u]BarIconMode (0-3)[/u]: Direction the icons will travel, before eventually swapping row/column. 0= Horisontal Icons, 1= Vertical Icons, 2= Vertical Icons + Text, 3= Disabled (no location bar for rods/pots, just minigame preview).
[*][u]BarTopLeftLocationX (0-X)[/u]: X coordinate of top left bar corner.
[*][u]BarTopLeftLocationY (0-X)[/u]: Y coordinate of top left bar corner.
[*][u]BarScale (0.1-10)[/u]: The bar already scales along with the UI, this allows you to fine-tune it.
[*][u]BarMaxIcons (4-500)[/u]: Maximum amount of icons displayed at the same time.
[*][u]BarMaxIconsPerRow (4-500)[/u]: Maximum amount of icons displayed before they change row/column.
[*][u]BarBackgroundMode (0-2)[/u]: Dark transparent background(s). 0= Circles behind each icon, 1= Single rectangle behind all icons, 2= Off.
[*][u]BarBackgroundColorRGBA[/u]: Colour of background in Integer RGBA, so 0-255 x4. Google a colour picker, the alpha value is also 0-255 (not 0-1).
[*][u]BarTextColorRGBA[/u]: Colour of text in Integer RGBA, so 0-255 x4, like [255, 255, 255, 255].
[*][u]BarExtraIconsMaxSize[/u]: true= Show a Star icon if max size of the fish hasn't been caught yet. false= off.
[*][u]BarExtraIconsBundles[/u]: true= Show a Bundle icon if the fish is needed for a Community Center bundle (if unlocked). false= off.
[*][u]BarExtraIconsAquarium[/u]: true= Show a Pufferfish icon if the fish is needed for Stardew Aquarium (if mod installed). false= off.
[*][u]BarExtraIconsAlwaysShow[/u]: Show Extra Icons even if the fish hasn't been caught before.
[*][u]BarUncaughtFishEffect (0-2)[/u]: When uncaught: 0= Darken fish. 1= Display a Bronze Star extra icon (ignores BarExtraIconsAlwaysShow). 2= Same as caught.
[*][u]BarShowBaitAndTackleInfo[/u]: true= Displays bait and tackle icons + counts in the bar (if equipped). false= off.
[*][u]BarShowPercentMode [/u][u](0-2)[/u]: 0/1= Displays percentage chance of catching a fish under its icon. Accuracy based on ExtraCheckFrequency, 2= off.
[*][u]BarSortMode (0-2)[/u]: 0= Icons are sorted by name. 1= Icons are sorted by catch chance percentage (heavily based on ExtraCheckFrequency, will likely jump), 2= Off (Trash, then IDs, then extras).
[*][u]BarExtraCheckFrequency (0-200)[/u]: 0-22= Generic (when 0) OR Simulated, runs the fishing minigame value*10 times per UI Update (higher is more accurate, but can impact performance). Generic is less accurate percentage-wise, but performs better.
[*][u]BarScanRadius (1-50)[/u]: Scans X tiles around player for water, and only shows fish info for the nearest tile found (if any).
[*][u]BarCrabPotEnabled[/u]: true= Enables the above preview for Crab Pots. false= Off.
[*][u]BarNonFishMode (0-2)[/u]: Whether the bar shows non-fish objects, like furniture and trash. 0= Same as fish. 1= Always caught. 2= Don't show.
[*][u][/u][u]MinigamePreviewBar[/u]: true= When reeling a fish it's highlighted on the Preview Bar. false= off.
[*][u]MinigamePreviewRod[/u]: true= When reeling a fish it's sprite is show in place of the generic minigame sprite. false= off.
[*][u]MinigamePreviewWater[/u]: true= When reeling a fish it's visible in the water (nibbling bobber). Transparency dependent on sonar setting & equipped. false= off.
[*][u]MinigamePreviewSonar[/u]: When reeling a fish shows base game sonar display.
[*][color=#878787][u]BarLegendaryMode (0-2) (pre 1.0.5)[/u]: If BarExtraCheckFrequency is above 0, this is ignored. 0= Vanilla [/color][color=#878787]Legendary Fish logic, 1= Vanilla + Always Show (cool if you have a mod that [i]only [/i]makes them re-catchable), 2= Never Show (cool if you don't want to see them, or have a mod that alters them).[/color]
[*][color=#878787][u]MinigameMode (0-3) [color=#878787][u][color=#878787][u](pre 1.2.5)[/u][/color][/u][/color][/u]: 0= Copies multiple layers to look better. 1= Only overlays the fish, looks worse, [/color][color=#878787][color=#878787]but might perform/work better. 2= Included in the above two: Outlines the fish in the regular location bar (if it's enabled). 3= Disabled.[/color][/color]
[*][color=#878787][u]BarShowPercent [color=#878787][u](pre 1.2.8)[/u][/color][/u]: true= Displays percentage chance of catching a fish under its icon. Accuracy based on ExtraCheckFrequency, false= off.[/color]
[*][color=#878787][u]BarExtraIconsUncaught [color=#878787][u](pre 1.2.8)[/u][/color][/u]: true= Show Extra Icons even if the fish hasn't been caught before. false= Show only when caught.[/color]
[*][color=#878787][color=#878787][u]OnlyFish [color=#878787][u](pre 1.3.1)[/u][/color][/u]: true= Only show things from the official fish list (and trash), skipping things like furniture or notes.[/color]
[/color]
[/list][/spoiler]

Downloads.Description:
Main File. Unpack folder into your Mods folder. Requires SMAPI. For 1.6.15+


1.2.9+: Overlay now tracks the caught status of non-fish objects. So non-fish will be marked as uncaught until you re-catch them after installation.
